scenario: [LSTR.11.1] / [LSTR.11.2]: a capacity counts codepoints as `len` does ([LSTR.2.1]), not bytes. The literal is five codepoints of two bytes each (ten bytes) written to a `capacity 5` slot, so it fits and the program compiles. PATH PINNED: `dsc.dstest.lstr_11_2_literal_capacity`'s `constant_codepoints`, which decodes the literal before counting. A check that measured the source bytes, or the encoded UTF-8 length, refuses this with `DS_VALIDATE_CAPACITY_LITERAL_EXCEEDED` and the vector goes red.
